physics-killer-06.title: Kumgangatho othe tye ongenakukhuhlana,
physics-killer-06.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-06.material: Kumgangatho othe tye ongenakukhuhlana, into A enobunzima $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ ihamba ngesantya $6\,\mathrm{m/s}$ kwaye ibethana nento B enobunzima $4\,\mathrm{kg}$ eyayimile, emva koko izinto zombini zinamathelana kwaye zihamba kunye. Xa ixesha lokubethana li-$0.05\,\mathrm{s}$, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa isantya sezinto zombini kanye emva kokubethana kunye nobungakanani bamandla aphakathi afunyenwe ngu-B ngexesha lokubethana?
physics-killer-06.s.s1.prompt: Kumgangatho othe tye ongenakukhuhlana, into A enobunzima $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ ihamba ngesantya $6\,\mathrm{m/s}$ kwaye ibethana nento B enobunzima $4\,\mathrm{kg}$ eyayimile, emva koko izinto zombini zinamathelana kwaye zihamba kunye. Xa ixesha lokubethana li-$0.05\,\mathrm{s}$, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa isantya sezinto zombini kanye emva kokubethana kunye nobungakanani bamandla aphakathi afunyenwe ngu-B ngexesha lokubethana?
physics-killer-06.s.s1.explain: Ukugcinwa kwenani lentshukumo: $2\cdot6=(2+4)v\Rightarrow v=2\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Utshintsho lwenani lentshukumo luka-B $\Delta p_B=4\cdot2-0=8\,\mathrm{kg\cdot m/s}$, ngoko $F_{avg}=\dfrac{8}{0.05}=160\,\mathrm{N}$. (Utshintsho lwenani lentshukumo luka-A $2(2-6)=-8$ kwaye ubungakanani buyafana, ngoko iyahambelana.) Ukuba kusetyenziswa $m_A$ kuphela endaweni yobunzima obudibeneyo, kuba $v=3\,\mathrm{m/s}$ impendulo engalunganga ①, ukuba inani lentshukumo yokuqala luka-A $12$ lisetyenziswa kwisibalo samandla, kuba $240\,\mathrm{N}$ (impendulo engalunganga ②), ukuba kusetyenziswa $v_B=4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ yokubethana okuguqukayo, ngumphendulo ongalunganga ③.
physics-killer-06.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-06.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
